papers.title: UniTeD: Unified Temporal Diffusion for Joint Perception and Planning in Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Bo Zhao, Xinting Zhao, Naifan Li, Erkang Cheng, Haibin Ling
papers.affiliations: Nullmax, Westlake University
papers.intro: UniTeD 是一个统一的时间扩散框架，通过共享生成空间中的迭代去噪同时建模感知和规划任务，并引入时间过渡模块和锚点刷新策略来解决时序不匹配和训练-推理分布偏移问题，在多个基准上取得最优性能。

papers.title: Efficient Real-World Dehazing via Physics-Inspired Global-Local Decoupling
papers.authors: Yifei Qu, Ru Li, Junjie Chen, Jinyuan Wu
papers.affiliations: Faculty of Computing, Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin 150006, China
papers.intro: 论文提出一种轻量级物理启发式全局-局部解耦网络（PGL-Net），通过算子级模拟嵌入物理归纳偏置，将去雾解耦为全局分布校正和局部结构精化，在多个真实世界基准上达到最先进恢复质量并显著降低计算复杂度。

papers.title: Falcon: Functional Assembly and Language for Compositional Reasoning in X-ray
papers.authors: Yonathan Michael, Mohamad Alansari, Natnael Takele, Andreas Henschel, Naoufel Werghi
papers.affiliations: Khalifa University (Computer Science Department, Center of Cyber-physical Systems)
papers.intro: 本文提出Falcon，一个多模态框架，通过将分割感知的区域特征抽象为包含组件存在、成对功能兼容性和场景风险的显式安全状态，并注入语言模型，实现X-ray图像中关系一致的结构化组合威胁推理。

papers.title: DiffusionBench: On Holistic Evaluation of Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Xingjian Leng, Jaskirat Singh, Zhanhao Liang, Ethan Smith, Martin Bell, Aninda Saha, Yuhui Yuan, Liang Zheng
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: Australian National University, Canva Research
papers.intro: 本文提出统一DiT训练框架NanoGen，证明ImageNet FID与T2I性能无强相关性，并构建结合两类任务的DiffusionBench基准，建议未来DiT研究应报告该基准而非仅ImageNet结果。

papers.title: FLAT: Feedforward Latent Triangle Splatting for Geometrically Accurate Scene Generation
papers.authors: Orest Kupyn, Goutam Bhat, Philipp Henzler, Fabian Manhardt, Christian Rupprecht, Federico Tombari
papers.affiliations: Google Research, University of Oxford (Visual Geometry Group), TU Munich
papers.intro: FLAT首次实现了从视频扩散潜在中直接解码非体积三角形泼溅基元，通过射线中心局部参数化和乘积窗口函数稳定训练，在保持竞争性视觉质量的同时显著提升几何精度，并支持轻量级测试时优化以转换为游戏引擎兼容的完全不透明表示。

papers.title: IV-CoT: Implicit Visual Chain-of-Thought for Structure-Aware Text-to-Image Generation
papers.authors: Zixuan Li, Haokun Lin, Yicheng Xiao, Zhiwei Li, Xinyang Song, Zelong Zheng, Yong He, Heng Yao, Ke Ding, Chao Yu, Chuan Yuan, Qi Li, Zhenan Sun
papers.affiliations: 1NLPR, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences；2Ant Group；3The University of Hong Kong
papers.intro: 本文提出隐式视觉链式推理（IV-CoT），通过结构到语义的查询级联和仅训练阶段的草图监督，使MLLM-DiT生成器在一个前向传播中内部完成潜在视觉规划，从而在不提取草图或解码中间图像的情况下显著提升结构感知的提示遵循能力。

papers.title: Bridging the Manifold Gap: Riemannian Residual Line Search for One-Step Image Editing
papers.authors: Hongzhu Yi, Zhongtian Luo, Tong Li, Yiyan Fan, Jungang Xu
papers.affiliations: Hongzhu Yi - UCAS, Zhongtian Luo - UCAS, Tong Li - WashU, Yiyan Fan - SHU, Jungang Xu - UCAS
papers.intro: 本文提出黎曼残差线搜索（RRLS）方法，通过联合一阶与二阶差分近似来估计能量场的局部时间曲率，并构造残差候选路径结合正则化选择，在不增加推理步数的情况下，在一系列一步编辑方法中实现了最优的编辑质量与保真度权衡。

papers.title: GeoT2V-Bench: Benchmarking 3D Consistency in Text-to-Video Models via 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Chenrui Fan, Paolo Favaro
papers.affiliations: University of Bern, Switzerland
papers.intro: 提出GeoT2V-Bench，一个基于重建的诊断基准，通过先拟合灵活的可变形高斯表示（DeformableGS）再提取静态代理（MedianGS）的两阶段方法，对相机提示的T2V视频进行连续重建剖面评估，揭示其作为静态场景采集的证据质量。

papers.title: High-Fidelity Synthetic Transmission Electron Microscopy Image Generation Using Diffusion Probabilistic Models for Data-Limited Semiconductor Metrology
papers.authors: Johannes Boehm, Bappaditya Dey
papers.affiliations: Chemnitz University of Technology, Germany; Interuniversity Microelectronics Centre (imec), Leuven, Belgium
papers.intro: 提出一种基于去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）的生成框架，通过渐进式补丁训练策略（从64×64到1024×1024分辨率）和定制化数据增强，在仅15张真实图像的极端数据稀缺条件下，生成高保真、符合FAB计量规范的合成TEM图像，并进一步利用DDPM中间特征实现无监督分割。

papers.title: DDStereo: Efficient Dual Decoder Transformers for Stereo 3D Road Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Shiyi Mu, Zichong Gu, Zhiqi Ai, Yilin Gao, Shugong Xu
papers.affiliations: 上海大学(Shiyi Mu, Zichong Gu, Zhiqi Ai, Yilin Gao), 西交利物浦大学(Shugong Xu)
papers.intro: 提出DDStereo，一种双解码器Transformer立体3D检测框架，通过解耦前景定位（基于视差）和3D属性回归（基于左视图），共享对象查询实现对齐，首次达到单目级推理速度（23.5ms），在闭集和开集基准上均取得SOTA。

papers.title: OrbitForge: Text-to-3D Scene Generation via Reconstruction-Anchored Video Synthesis
papers.authors: Chenrui Fan, Paolo Favaro
papers.affiliations: Computer Vision Group, Institute of Computer Science, University of Bern, Switzerland
papers.intro: OrbitForge提出一个无需任务特定微调或分数蒸馏优化的适配器，通过将冻结的文本到视频模型与两阶段3D高斯泼溅重建锚定相结合，将单个文本生成的视频转换为完整的闭环轨道3D场景。

papers.title: EG-VQA: Benchmarking Verifiable Video Question Answering with Grounded Temporal Evidence
papers.authors: Linpeng Huang, Weixing Chen, Zexin Chen, Yang Liu, Liang Lin
papers.affiliations: Sun Yat-sen University, Peng Cheng Laboratory, Shenzhen University
papers.intro: 本文提出EG-VQA基准，要求视频问答模型同时给出答案和可验证的时间证据，并基于该基准训练EG-Reasoner模型，揭示了仅靠模型规模扩展不足以实现可靠的视频理解，显式结构化证据监督至关重要。

papers.title: Counting Trees from Satellite Imagery with Noisy Supervision
papers.authors: Dimitri Gominski, Maurice Mugabowindekwe, Qiue Xu, Xiaowei Tong, Martin Brandt, Hieu Le, Rasmus Fensholt, Dimitris Samaras, Loic Landrieu
papers.affiliations: University of Copenhagen, University of Rwanda, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, University of North Carolina at Charlotte, Stony Brook University, LIGM, CNRS, Univ Gustave Eiffel, ENPC, IPP
papers.intro: 本文提出TREEMATCH，一种基于不平衡最优传输的密度匹配框架，结合自纠正机制有效利用噪声弱监督，在覆盖三大陆、三传感器的TINYTREES基准上实现了优于检测、回归和分布匹配方法的树木计数性能。

papers.title: AerialFusionMapNet: Online HD Map Construction with Aerial-Onboard BEV Fusion
papers.authors: Daniel Lengerer, Mathias Pechinger, Klaus Bogenberger, Carsten Markgraf
papers.affiliations: Technical University of Applied Sciences Augsburg, Technical University of Munich
papers.intro: 本文提出AerialFusionMapNet，通过结构化两阶段训练策略（航拍仅预训练+跨视图监督）实现航拍与车载BEV特征的有效融合，在nuScenes地理分割上达到54.7 mAP，超越先前航拍-车载融合基线12.1%。

papers.title: CineCap: Structured Reasoning with Spatio-Temporal Anchors for Cinematographic Video Captioning
papers.authors: Xinyu Mao, Yuhui Zeng, Xiaokun Liu, Wenyu Qin, Meng Wang, Xin Tao, Pengfei Wan, Xiaohan Xing, Max Meng
papers.affiliations: Xinyu Mao - The Chinese University of Hong Kong, HKSAR（本工作于快手科技Kling团队实习期间完成） Yuhui Zeng - Xiamen University, China（本工作于快手科技Kling团队实习期间完成） Xiaokun Liu - Kling Team, Kuaishou Technology, China Wenyu Qin - Kling Team, Kuaishou Technology, China Meng Wang - Kling Team, Kuaishou Technology, China Xin Ta
papers.intro: CineCap 提出了一种结合时空锚点结构化推理与强化学习（含全面性、准确性、门控覆盖奖励）的框架，在多维电影摄影字幕生成任务上显著超越现有闭源和开源模型，并构建了首个专门的评测基准 CineCap Bench。

papers.title: ViTexQA: A Multi-Frame Temporal Perception Dataset for Video Text Question Answering
papers.authors: Zhentao Guo, Chen Duan, Tongkun Guan, Zining Wang, Kai Zhou, Pengfei Yan
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual question answering, OCR, video segmentation, video search
papers.affiliations: Meituan（美团）；Shanghai Jiao Tong University（上海交通大学）
papers.intro: 本文提出了ViTexQA——首个专门针对多帧时间感知的视频文本问答数据集（所有问题均无法从单帧回答），并配套提出了FrameThinker训练方法，通过CoT引导的监督微调和时间接地强化学习两阶段训练，显著提升了MLLMs的跨帧文本推理能力。

papers.title: Towards Fast and Effective Long Video Understanding of Multimodal Large Language Models via Adaptive Quasi-Gaussian Sampling
papers.authors: Kun Zhang, Chenxin Fang, Tao Chen, Baiyang Song, Yunhang Shen, Yiyi Zhou, Rongrong Ji
papers.affiliations: Key Laboratory of Multimedia Trusted Perception and Efficient Computing, Ministry of Education of China, Xiamen University
papers.intro: 本文将视频帧选择重新定义为自适应拟高斯采样问题，提出一种无需训练的AdaQ方法，利用3-σ规则和帧-查询相似度方差自适应调节采样分布，在仅需一个超参数的情况下显著提升MLLMs的长视频理解性能。

papers.title: Token-to-Token Alignment of Text Embeddings for Semantic Blending
papers.authors: Saar Huberman, Ron Mokady, Or Patashnik, Daniel Cohen-Or
papers.affiliations: Saar Huberman - Tel Aviv University, BRIA AI Or Patashnik - Tel Aviv University Daniel Cohen-Or - Tel Aviv University
papers.intro: 提出Token-to-Token对齐框架，通过结构对齐和嵌入对齐建立跨提示词的显式语义对应，使线性插值在文本嵌入空间中产生连贯的语义轨迹，实现连续合成、编辑和混合。

papers.title: Cyclic Denoising Reveals Ultrastable Memories in Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Rishabh Sharma, Stefano Martiniani
papers.affiliations: New York University
papers.intro: 本文提出循环去噪（cyclic denoising）——对样本进行重复的部分前向-反向扩散——作为一种物理启发的动力学工具，能够揭示扩散模型中隐藏的超稳定记忆吸引子（对应记忆的训练图像），并实现无需提示、无需训练集访问的提取攻击。

papers.title: 3D Masked Autoencoders are Robust Learners of Volumetric and Multimodal Cellular Representations for Microscopy
papers.authors: Amirhossein Kardoost, Lion Gleiter, Tingying Peng, Carsten Marr
papers.affiliations: Institute of AI for Health & Helmholtz AI, Computational Health Center, Helmholtz Munich – German Research Center for Environmental Health, Neuherberg, Germany
papers.intro: 本文系统比较了2D与3D掩码自编码器（MAE）在体积显微镜数据上的表现，证明原生3D建模与通道交叉注意力、频域正则化及蛋白质语言模型对齐可显著提升单细胞下游任务的表示质量，实现了蛋白定位和蛋白-蛋白相互作用的新SOTA。
